subject: DSN-ARGV-FIX landed b71d9c0 — CWE-214, CRPS |x-y|, gate fail-closed, census coverage
body:
Verified all four #865 hypotheses before fixing.
1. CWE-214 REAL. Both runners now spawn psql with PGHOST/PGUSER/PGPASSWORD/PGDATABASE/PGSSLMODE in the child env. argv is flags+SQL only. Test asserts the password is not in argv.
2. CRPS outside support REAL, but the bot example was slightly off: delta_3 vs y=5 returned 1 not 0; vs y=1 returned 0. Correct identity CRPS(delta_x,y)=|x-y|. Loop the support, add the gap in O(1). Tests pin 2, 2, 1 and match crpsEmpirical.
3. evaluateCrpsGate NaN REAL. minImprovement:NaN made both comparisons false and survived. Now throws. Negative and minN<1 also throw.
4. Census coverage REAL for adverse_edge. hasEdge was the denominator while pricesWorseThanMarket is silence on non-finite expectedClv. Coverage now requires finite expectedClv; a SPEAK row with NaN clv is unobserved for adverse_edge, not a measured zero.
GEM-2 stays gemini. MARKET-5PP stays NOT_RUN. Next: score-veto reason codes (shadow, scoreGames return type unchanged), then Venn width by calibration DEPTH not sport.
